description: Each month, long the 4 commodity futures with the strongest 12-month return (skipping the last month) and short the 4 weakest: energy, metals, grains, softs and livestock. Backtested on FinzData futures: each market is its front-month contract rolled on the FinzData roll calendar, as an excess-return index (no interest on collateral), 5 bps costs per trade, re-run free on full history.
title: Commodity futures momentum 12-1 · long/short · top 4 of 17 (after Miffre & Rallis 2007)
